scope: Only the 7 rows that v4 left UNRESOLVED. The other 48 rows keep their v4 evidence. This is research, not a scan: no source was added, enabled or fetched, and no job-listing API was called.
rules: Owner-machine requests only, descriptive read-only User-Agent, a pause between requests to one host.
robots.txt honoured with an RFC 9309 matcher: 4xx = unavailable (allowed), 5xx or network failure = disallow all, redirects followed up to five hops.
No login, apply path, CAPTCHA or bot-protection bypass; a challenge or rejection page ends the attempt.
Officialness: only the employer's own domain, or an ATS or destination linked or redirected to from it, counts. ATS branding alone stays an unverified lead.
'Supported feed' means an ASTRA adapter it may use (Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby). SmartRecruiters stays an Owner decision.
counts_note: v4 had 0 / 48 / 7. The seven rows were re-researched; none has a newly verified jobs or application route. PureHealth has an employer-directed company-profile lead, but no verified jobs fallback.
not_claimed: No posting is claimed open, and no row is covered automatically.
The Owner's separate controlled scan of configured board sources does not cover or validate these employers.

rows.destination: The employer's own careers path answers HTTP 301 to its LinkedIn company page, https://www.linkedin.com/company/purehealthae/.
rows.blocker: The destination is a LinkedIn company profile, not a verified jobs or application page. LinkedIn robots.txt disallows this client, so no jobs route there was checked. It is an employer-directed navigation lead, not a working direct-link fallback.
rows.evidence: The redirect is served by the employer's own domain. purehealth.ae robots.txt answered 403, which RFC 9309 treats as unavailable; the one careers request was answered with a redirect, not a challenge, so no bot protection was met or bypassed. The earlier v4 Cloudflare block on this host was not reproduced for this path.

rows.blocker: www.zu.ac.ae still resets the TLS connection at robots.txt (WinError 10054), so ZU's own careers page cannot be read to show a forward link.
rows.evidence: The Oracle Candidate Experience landing page answered 200 with the title 'Zayed University': branding only, not an official link under the rule.

rows.blocker: /en/Careers is allowed by robots.txt but returns a web-application-firewall 'Request Rejected' page (not bypassed).
rows.evidence: The Arabic FAQ page loads, but its served HTML has no careers answer or ADPHC e-mail address, so the earlier remote-reader lead (a CV e-mail route) is not confirmed from this machine.

rows.official_link_observed: DoH's homepage (https://www.doh.gov.ae/en/) links 'Careers' to an Oracle E-Business Suite page on aderp.abudhabi.ae.
rows.blocker: aderp.abudhabi.ae fails TLS verification ('certificate has expired'), so its robots.txt is unreadable and nothing there is fetched; a browser would show a certificate warning. /en/careers on doh.gov.ae redirects to a 404 page.
rows.evidence: The official link is verified from the employer's page, but its destination is not usable, so it is not offered as a working fallback.

rows.blocker: Both /en/about-us/careers and /en/careers return a Cloudflare 'Attention Required' challenge (HTTP 403, not bypassed).
rows.evidence: The Oracle landing page answered 200 titled 'Emirate Islamic Bank Recruitment Team': branding only.

rows.blocker: robots.txt on hct.ac.ae and www.hct.ac.ae still redirects in a loop, so it is treated as unreachable and no HCT page is fetched.
rows.evidence: The Oracle landing page answered 200 titled 'HCT': branding only.

rows.blocker: du.ae robots.txt disallows every path for all agents, so no du page is fetched.
rows.evidence: The Oracle landing page answered 200 titled 'du Careers': branding only.
